title: 第2266章 这就是无敌的第2265章 应该的
lines: 在李维贤和祖大寿、吴三桂等人南下这段时间里，后金的问题的确得到了不少解决，后金新大汗莽古尔泰最终只带走了两个完整的旗和六个报废的旗出了关。
满桂等人也趁着辽东空虚，轻松破了辽阳、沈阳等城市收服失地，这个万历后期就反叛大明割据辽东的军事集团，一下子就被打的废了八九成。
没了边关之患，就算郑芝龙再怎么看不起大明水师的力量，也不敢再有反意了。
他很清楚没有外患压力，而陕西一带的民变也只是小打小闹状态，一旦朝廷得知了他坐镇东南海的真正收益，只是为了财富，大明朝廷也能组建起一支恐怖的舰队来打他。
那一艘犹如神魔般的海上城市钢铁船，那一杆杆能比火炮威胁力还更大的崇祯二年步枪，都是如山一样的压力，压得郑芝龙根本无力喘息。
所以，当李维贤和祖大寿等人入城，尤其是吴襄为首的辽东兵将去拜会了福建巡抚、福州知府等人后，晚上一场浩大的接风宴结束，郑芝龙就哭丧着脸凑了六十万两银子送给三方。
李维贤、祖大寿、吴襄每方20万两。
在李维贤暂居的客栈里，让人清点一番后，李维贤就叼着牙签吐槽道，“真小气，本府都那么热情的陪他演了一场了，才20万两、打发叫花子呢？”
客房里，祖大寿一脸懵逼，就这？就你在福州城外说了几句话，客套一番，这就敲诈来20万两？
他祖大寿也有一份20万两的白银呢，郑芝龙真的这么富有？即便祖大寿在辽东也见惯了各式各样的大钱，每年四五百万的辽饷啊，可是，那些毕竟是被满朝文武层层大手都要刮一刮的。
到了祖大寿手里时，一年能到手几十万两就不错了。
现在却是李知府随口敲几句，真有六十万送来了！
吴襄都忍不住惊叹道，“这位郑游击可是比我们想象到的更富有啊。”
李维贤不屑的瞥了吴襄一眼，“我早说了，他一年卖旗一千万两可能是夸张了点，但也八九不离十。”
“每年啊，比你们和满朝文武结合起来，全国搜刮的辽饷都要翻倍，你们还是满朝文武分那点钱，郑芝龙几乎是郑家独享，他只需要打点一下熊文灿就行了。”
“但熊文灿估计也只是喝了点汤，这位巡抚根本不清楚海贸的财富到底有多大。”
“远的不说，就在弯弯更南方的马尼拉，每年都有佛郎机人的运金运银船路过，你们要是有胆子和本官抢一把，一抢几百万两小意思。”
伴随李知府豪迈的话语，祖大寿都喷饭了，真的假的，除了郑芝龙那么富有，更南方的马尼拉什么的，也有人每年成船成船的运输金银财富？
一把抢个几百万两？
这日子有些太魔幻了吧，他们和大明朝廷的文武高官们，敲诈全大明子民才能搞出来几百万辽饷，这不起眼的南边，原本只是他们眼中的蛮荒之地，这么有钱？
李维贤再次道，“我不知道你们辽东兵，什么时候才能适应海战，海浪的颠簸，但我可以负责任告诉你们，越早适应那些，就代表几十几百万两的银子，在等着大家去抢。”
“本府等得起，就看你们等不等得起了。”
“不过在这福州，没能从郑芝龙手里敲诈个四五百万两之前，本府是不打算去弯弯赴任的。”
他何止现在不会急着去赴任？不等到石油生意运过来，给现代游轮重新加满油之前，他都不急着出城。
要是坐郑芝龙的船去弯弯，那家伙被敲诈狠了，未必不会心狠手辣来个翻船。
李知府说到做到，从这一天起他就和祖大寿等人扎根福州城了，一直等了一个多月，等着一船船装在铁桶里的原油船南下来了福州，他才用敲诈自郑芝龙的银子付账……
这些木质油船能这么快来福州，还是得益于大明境内各种水利措施了，陕西巡抚孙传庭得了六十万两银子，在延长大肆雇佣民壮挖地挖油，如预期中那样，干活能有饭吃，孙传庭雇来的人都是海量的。
能有口饭吃，谁愿意拿着木棍去和高迎祥、李自成去造反啊。
石油到了的第二天，很久已经没有动静的现代邮轮，就从海南某偏僻处，杀来了福州城外。
当现代游轮杀入港口时，那种冲击力，真的……吓尿了无数人，连郑家水师们都有好多感受到了来自灵魂上的战栗惊悚感。
这两三个月过去，群穿客们也不是毫无发展的，至少他们大部分都穿上了明代制式的服装，开始留长发，还有很多学会了一口大明官话，和这里的人交流是可以的。
游轮光明正大现身，也是大家集体商议后作出的决定，这就是震慑。
震慑一下郑芝龙让他别起乱七八糟的心思，为了更进一步震慑，游轮还在入港时，不小心意外撞翻了一艘五十米长的福船，那场面，就像是行走中的霸王龙，不小心撞翻了路边一个小树苗。
当然，大家不是杀人狂魔，那翻掉的福船上本就是停在港口，没什么人在上面的，这还是吴船长用望远镜认真分辨寻找出的目标。
然后，当天晚上，李知府为首，带领一群福州官员和祖大寿等人上船时，没有见到多少群穿客，他们这几个月已经在海南停船带附近，建了一个小小的基地，绝大部分群穿客都是在基地里。
就算这样，上百个穿着锦衣卫服饰的船员，在李知府带领下，让整艘船发出亮如白昼的灯光撕裂夜幕，那种冲击力，是史无前例的颠覆。
郑芝龙再次如丧考妣，在他见识过红外线望远镜、以及游轮上巨大的探照灯后，他就知道，这艘神一样的大船，连夜袭群殴纵火什么的偷袭方案，通通不管用。
这个飘荡在海洋上的钢铁城市，不需要什么火炮火铳，只需要用它钢铁外墙横冲直撞，足以轻松撕碎郑家所有船队，也足以屠杀佛郎机人各式各样的舰队商队。
content_en:
During the time when Li Weixian, Zu Dashou, Wu Sangui and others went south, the problems of Hou Jin were indeed solved a lot. Mang Gurtai, the new great Khan of Hou Jin, finally took only two complete flags and six scrapped flags out of the customs.
Man Gui and others also took advantage of the emptiness in Liaodong to easily conquer cities such as Liaoyang and Shenyang and conquer the lost territory. This military group that rebelled against the Ming Dynasty in the late Wanli period to separatize Liaodong was defeated by 80 to 90% in one fell swoop.
Without the border troubles, no matter how much Zheng Zhilong looked down on the strength of the Ming Navy, he would not dare to rebel again.
He knew very well that there was no pressure from foreign aggression, and the civil unrest in Shaanxi was just a minor disturbance. Once the court learned of his true gains from sitting in the Southeast China Sea, just for wealth, the Ming court could also build a terrifying fleet to fight against him.
That steel ship that looked like a god and demon in the sea city, and that Chongzhen 2nd Year Rifle, which was more threatening than the artillery, were all under pressure like a mountain, and Zheng Zhilong was unable to breathe at all.
Therefore, when Li Weixian, Zu Dashou and others entered the city, especially the Liaodong soldiers led by Wu Xiang went to visit the governor of Fujian, the prefect of Fuzhou and others, and after a grand reception banquet ended in the evening, Zheng Zhilong sadly collected 600,000 taels of silver and gave it to the three parties.
Li Weixian, Zu Dashou and Wu Xiang each paid 200,000 taels.
In the inn where Li Weixian stayed temporarily, after being counted, Li Weixian complained with a toothpick in his mouth, "How stingy. I have been so enthusiastic to accompany him to perform a performance, and only 200,000 taels are sent to him as a beggar?"
In the guest room, Zu Dashou looked confused, that's it? You just said a few words and were polite outside Fuzhou City, and now you want to extort 200,000 taels?
His ancestor Dashou also had a share of 200,000 taels of silver. Is Zheng Zhilong really so rich? Even Zu Dashou was used to seeing all kinds of big money in Liaodong, four to five million Liao salaries every year, but after all, these were scrapped by the powerful hands of the civil and military officials of the entire dynasty.
When it comes to Zu Dashou, it will be good to get hundreds of thousands of taels a year.
Now, it was Magistrate Li who casually said that 600,000 yuan had been delivered!
Wu Xiang couldn't help but exclaimed, "This Zheng Youyi is richer than we imagined."
Li Weixian glanced at Wu Xiang disdainfully, "I told you before that selling 10 million taels of flags a year may be an exaggeration, but it's still close to ten."
"Every year, compared with the combination of you and the civil and military forces of the Manchu Dynasty, the Liao salary collected across the country is doubled. You still share the money with the civil and military forces of the Manchu Dynasty. Zheng Zhilong is almost exclusive to the Zheng family. He only needs to take care of Xiong Wencan."
"But Xiong Wencan probably just drank some soup. The governor has no idea how rich Haimao is."
"Not to mention that far away, in Manila, which is further south, there are gold and silver ships from the Franco people passing by every year. If you have the courage to grab a piece of it from me, it will be worth a few million to steal it."
"Pfft~"
Following Magistrate Li's heroic words, Zu Dashou was furious. Is it true or not, apart from Zheng Zhilong being so rich, there are also people in Manila and other places further south who transport gold and silver wealth in ships every year?
Grab a few million taels in one hand?
These days are a bit too magical. They and the high-ranking civil and military officials of the Ming Dynasty had to blackmail all the people of the Ming Dynasty to get millions of dollars in wages. This inconspicuous south was originally just a barbaric land in their eyes. So rich?
Li Weixian said again, "I don't know when you Liaodong soldiers will be able to adapt to naval battles and the bumps of the waves, but I can tell you responsibly that the sooner you adapt to this, it means tens of millions of taels of silver, waiting for everyone to grab it."
"If I can afford to wait, it depends on whether you can afford to wait."
"But in Fuzhou, I have no intention of taking up my post in Wanwan until I can extort four to five million taels from Zheng Zhilong."
Why wouldn't he be in a hurry to take up his post now? He was not in a hurry to leave the city until the oil business arrived to refill the modern cruise ship.
If we take Zheng Zhilong's boat to go to Wanwan, that guy has been blackmailed so much that he may not be ruthless enough to capsize the boat.
Magistrate Li kept his word. From that day on, he and Zu Dashou and others took root in Fuzhou City. They waited for more than a month for crude oil ships packed in iron barrels to come south to Fuzhou, and then he used the money extorted from Zheng Zhilong to pay the bill...
The reason why these wooden oil ships came to Fuzhou so quickly was due to the various water conservancy measures in the Ming Dynasty. Sun Chuanting, the governor of Shaanxi Province, received 600,000 taels of silver and hired people to dig for oil in Yanchang. As expected, he was able to eat while working. Sun Chuanting hired a large number of people.
Who would want to rebel with Gao Yingxiang and Li Zicheng with wooden sticks if they could have food to eat?
The day after the oil arrived, a modern cruise ship, which had been silent for a long time, arrived outside Fuzhou from a remote place in Hainan.
When the modern cruise ship entered the port, the impact really...scared countless people to the point of peeing. Even many of the Zheng family's sailors felt the trembling horror in their souls.
In the past two or three months, the group of tourists has not developed without development. At least most of them have put on Ming Dynasty-style clothes and started to grow their hair long. Many of them have learned to speak Ming Dynasty Mandarin, and they can communicate with people here.
The cruise ship appeared openly and openly, and it was a decision made after collective discussion. This is a shock.
To shock Zheng Zhilong, he stopped his messy thoughts. In order to further shock him, the cruise ship accidentally knocked over a fifty-meter-long fortune ship when it was still entering the port. The scene was like a walking Tyrannosaurus Rex accidentally knocking over a small sapling on the roadside.
Of course, we are not murderers. The overturned fortune boat was originally parked in the port, and there was no one on it. This was the target that Captain Wu carefully identified with his binoculars.
Then, that night, when Magistrate Li led a group of Fuzhou officials, Zu Dashou and others on board the ship, they did not see many groups of passengers. They had built a small base near the Hainan boat docking area in the past few months, and most of the group passengers were in the base.
Even so, hundreds of crew members dressed in Jinyiwei uniforms, under the leadership of Governor Li, made the entire ship emit light as bright as day and tear apart the night. The impact was unprecedented and subversive.
Zheng Zhilong once again felt like he was mourning. After he saw the infrared telescope and the huge searchlight on the cruise ship, he knew that the sneak attack plan of this god-like ship, including a night attack and arson, would not work.
This steel city floating on the ocean does not need any artillery or muskets. It only needs to use its steel outer wall to smash through it. It is enough to easily tear apart all the Zheng family's fleet, and it is also enough to massacre the various fleets and caravans of the Franji people.
